beats.label: S1 · Widow deals to neighbours
beats.text: Widowed suburban mom Nancy Botwin deals weed to affluent Agrestic neighbours to keep her boys afloat, buying wholesale from South Central dealer Heylia James.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the whole premise and Nancy's supply relationship with Heylia.

beats.label: S1 · Andy moves in
beats.text: Judah's slacker brother Andy shows up uninvited from Alaska, and his chaotic streak nearly gets him thrown out before Nancy grudgingly lets him stay.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Andy is now core family — every future season depends on him being embedded here.

beats.label: S1 · Enter Conrad
beats.text: Through Heylia's nephew Conrad, Nancy discovers a superior product and starts baking edibles, sharpening her from small-time dealer into a real operator.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Conrad's arrival is the wedge that ultimately splits Nancy from Heylia and gives her a partner.

beats.label: S1 · The bakery cover
beats.text: Corrupt councilman Doug Wilson helps Nancy open a sham bakery to launder cash, giving her a public-facing front and pulling him deep into her orbit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Doug as a recurring accomplice and gives Nancy legitimate cover.

beats.label: S1 · Meeting Peter
beats.text: Nancy meets single dad Peter Scottson at a karate tournament and sparks a romance, her first adult connection since Judah's death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the romantic entanglement that becomes the season's whole cliffhanger.

beats.label: S1 · Conrad breaks with Heylia
beats.text: Conrad splits from Heylia to grow his own signature strain, recruiting Nancy, Andy, Doug and Sanjay into a partnership that finally makes her a producer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nancy's promotion from dealer to grower defines her scale for S2.

beats.label: S1 · Peter is DEA
beats.text: After sleeping with Peter, Nancy spots his DEA badge — the man closest to her is the one who can end her operation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger; frames every choice in S2.

cliffhanger.text: Nancy has just discovered her new boyfriend Peter is a DEA agent, at the exact moment she's committed to grow her own crop with Conrad.
questions: Will Peter arrest Nancy the moment he realises she's a dealer?
Can Nancy keep the grow operation hidden from a man sleeping in her bed?
Will Conrad stay in business with her if he finds out?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Widowed Agrestic mom who has just started dealing weed and unknowingly slept with a DEA agent.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Judah's slacker brother who moved in uninvited and drifts through the household causing chaos.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Nancy's teenage older son, just found out his mother is a drug dealer and is furious at being lied to.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Nancy's younger son, coping with Judah's death through violent, disturbing behaviour.

characters.name: Conrad Shepard
characters.line: Heylia's nephew and master grower; Nancy's new business partner behind Heylia's back.

characters.name: Heylia James
characters.line: South Central dealer who supplied Nancy; furious that Conrad has broken away with her.

characters.name: Peter Scottson
characters.line: Single dad Nancy just slept with, revealed at the end of the season to be a DEA agent.

characters.name: Celia Hodes
characters.line: Nancy's neighbour and PTA president, midway through breast cancer treatment and a collapsing marriage.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: Crooked city councilman who set up Nancy's cover bakery and is now one of her best customers.

beats.label: S2 · Vegas marriage of convenience
beats.text: To block Peter from ever testifying against her, Nancy elopes with him in Vegas — a marriage-of-convenience wedding ring around the DEA man's finger.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The spousal-privilege gambit defines every Peter/Nancy scene from here.

beats.label: S2 · MILF weed
beats.text: Nancy and Conrad rent a grow house and cultivate a hybrid Snoop Dogg dubs MILF weed, which quickly makes serious money and puts them on kingpin U-Turn's radar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: MILF is the crop everyone fights over for the next several seasons.

beats.label: S2 · Silas sabotages the condom
beats.text: Silas punctures a condom to trap Megan; her parents force an abortion and she leaves, breaking Silas and ending the relationship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains Silas's bitterness and volatility through the rest of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Celia takes power
beats.text: Celia narrowly beats Doug for the Agrestic council seat and launches an anti-drug crusade, planting cameras aimed straight at her old friend Nancy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Celia becomes a state-backed threat to Nancy's operation.

beats.label: S2 · Peter forces the harvest
beats.text: Peter wiretaps Nancy admitting the marriage was a con, then confronts her and Conrad at gunpoint demanding one final harvest before he'll disappear.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The crisis that draws all the guns to the grow house.

beats.label: S2 · Heylia hires the hit
beats.text: Threatened by Peter's investigation, Heylia quietly hires the Armenian kingpin Kashishian to murder him — a debt Nancy doesn't yet know she owes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Peter's death is the mechanism that reshuffles S3's power map.

beats.label: S2 · Silas steals the crop
beats.text: As Kashishian's men come to collect payment for Peter's murder, Nancy opens the safe and finds the MILF gone — Silas stole it, and Celia has just spotted him with it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger — five guns and the crop missing.

cliffhanger.text: Nancy stands surrounded by five drawn guns — U-Turn wants his cut, Kashishian's men want their fee for Peter, the MILF is missing, and Celia is confronting Silas in her driveway with the entire stolen stash.
questions: Can Nancy talk her way out of five guns with nothing to hand over?
What does U-Turn do once he learns her teenage son has the MILF?
Will Celia finally connect Silas to Nancy's operation?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Married Peter to block his testimony while running a full grow-house operation with Conrad.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Broken by Megan's forced abortion and departure; just stole the entire MILF crop from the safe.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Just gave a scorched valedictory speech at his elementary school graduation; freshly aware his mother deals.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Dodged the reserves via rabbinical school and then quit; now ordered to report for duty.

characters.name: Conrad Shepard
characters.line: Nancy's business partner and unrequited lover; furious she married a DEA agent.

characters.name: Heylia James
characters.line: Secretly hired the Armenian Kashishian to murder Peter and protect her operation.

characters.name: Celia Hodes
characters.line: New Agrestic council member on an anti-drug crusade, sleeping with Doug, exiled by Dean.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: Lost his council seat to Celia; having an affair with her and kicked out by Dean after Celia confessed.

characters.name: Peter Scottson
characters.line: Nancy's DEA-agent husband; just murdered outside the grow house by Heylia's Armenian hit.

characters.name: U-Turn
characters.line: South Central kingpin who has just learned Nancy and Conrad are producing MILF weed.

beats.label: S3 · Weed in the pool
beats.text: U-Turn spares Nancy on debt-work, but a livid Celia dumps the entire MILF crop in her pool, wiping out the harvest and Nancy's chance to pay him back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Nancy permanently in debt to U-Turn — the whole first half of the season runs off this.

beats.label: S3 · Guillermo takes over
beats.text: Marvin murders U-Turn during a heart attack and takes over the operation; Nancy pays off her debt with returned heroin after Guillermo routs Marvin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Guillermo is the man who defines every following season for Nancy.

beats.label: S3 · A straight job with Groff
beats.text: Nancy takes a straight job with slick developer Sullivan Groff, and starts sleeping with him — a brief flirtation with a legitimate life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Celia rivalry that turns lethal by season's end.

beats.label: S3 · Peter's body surfaces
beats.text: Peter's body is found in a rainstorm; DEA Captain Roy Till quietly buries the investigation to protect his agency's reputation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Till, who becomes Nancy's DEA counterparty later.

beats.label: S3 · Celia's knife point
beats.text: Celia catches Nancy in bed with Groff and turns predator — threatening to expose the dealing until Nancy pulls a knife to her throat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The friendship is now a mutual-destruction pact that carries forward.

beats.label: S3 · Grow moves to Celia's
beats.text: Silas learns to grow under Conrad, and Nancy sleeps with Conrad again, but a fire-marshal visit forces the grow house to relocate — into Celia's new home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Consolidates Silas as a grower and pulls Celia into the operation.

beats.label: S3 · Nancy burns Agrestic down
beats.text: As Celia rats her out and a wildfire consumes Majestic, Nancy torches her own house to erase evidence and drives south to traffic pot for Guillermo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal end of the Agrestic era and the launch into cartel life.

cliffhanger.text: Agrestic and Majestic are burning. Nancy has torched her own house, agreed to smuggle for Guillermo, and taken the family somewhere new.
questions: Can a suburban mom survive working for a Mexican cartel?
Will the DEA link the burned grow house back to her?
Where do the Botwins land now that Agrestic is ash?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Just burned down her house and agreed to smuggle pot across the Mexican border for Guillermo.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Trained as a grower under Conrad; broke up with Tara after her religious extremism.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Deep in denial about Judah's death, talking to him as if he were living in the house.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Honorably discharged from the reserves; catering porn shoots and dating biker Denise.

characters.name: Conrad Shepard
characters.line: Grower who slept with Nancy again but sees no future with her; staying behind as she flees.

characters.name: Celia Hodes
characters.line: Divorced, humiliated, and just now the informant who ratted Nancy out to the DEA.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: Back on council, addicted to stolen narcotics; on the run after stealing Majestic's Christian cross.

characters.name: Guillermo
characters.line: Head of the Mexican gang doing business with U-Turn/Marvin; has just invited Nancy to traffic across the border.

characters.name: Captain Roy Till
characters.line: DEA captain who covered up Peter's dirty dealings and is now investigating the MILF grow.

beats.label: S4 · Ren Mar and Bubbie
beats.text: The Botwins land in Ren Mar with Andy's father Lenny and dying grandmother Bubbie; Nancy soon confesses she burned down the old house.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the new location and the family's shared knowledge that Nancy destroyed their home.

beats.label: S4 · The maternity-store tunnel
beats.text: Guillermo turns Nancy into a border courier, running a maternity store that fronts a hidden tunnel to Mexico for pot, heroin, guns and trafficked women.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The tunnel is the season's entire operational core.

beats.label: S4 · Meeting Esteban
beats.text: Guillermo's boss Esteban Reyes — the mayor of Tijuana — takes an interest in Nancy, and their volatile, blood-drawing affair begins.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the cartel head who defines the next two seasons of Nancy's life.

beats.label: S4 · Celia crashes out
beats.text: Till releases Celia to spy on Guillermo; she's captured, spared by Nancy, then hooked on cocaine while guarding the tunnel until Nancy fires her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains Celia's total collapse and why she is exiled from the family in S5.

beats.label: S4 · Shane's darkness hardens
beats.text: Shane becomes the most-feared kid at his new school and loses his virginity to two goth girls.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Shane-as-killer arc that becomes central next season starts here.

beats.label: S4 · Nancy flips to Till
beats.text: Unable to stomach the human trafficking, Nancy flips to Captain Till as a DEA informant and helps him raid the maternity store.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The betrayal that makes Esteban her enemy.

beats.label: S4 · The ultrasound
beats.text: Cesar tortures Agent Schlatter into naming Nancy; to save herself from execution, Nancy hands Esteban an ultrasound revealing his unborn son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger — Nancy's life hinges on the pregnancy.

cliffhanger.text: Esteban knows Nancy betrayed him and was going to have her killed — but she is carrying his child. Her survival is now contingent on delivering him a son.
questions: Will Esteban let Nancy live once the child is born?
How does the DEA respond to one of their own being tortured to death?
What happens if the baby isn't a boy — or isn't his?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Running a maternity-store front and drug tunnel for Esteban; pregnant with his son.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Growing his own MILF plants in a cheese shop and sleeping with the shop's owner Lisa.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Openly violent and sexually active at 13.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Newly in love with Nancy; ran a coyote business smuggling immigrants until it collapsed.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: Fled Agrestic embezzlement to hide in Ren Mar; failed border militia and coyote ventures.

characters.name: Celia Hodes
characters.line: Cocaine-addicted, fired informant, kicked out by Nancy and estranged from her own family.

characters.name: Esteban Reyes
characters.line: Mayor of Tijuana and cartel boss; Nancy's lover, now aware she betrayed him.

characters.name: Guillermo
characters.line: Nancy's handler and rival within Esteban's cartel; wants her dead.

characters.name: Captain Roy Till
characters.line: DEA captain who flipped Nancy as an informant against Esteban's cartel.

beats.label: S5 · Spared and reclaimed
beats.text: Esteban spares Nancy for the pregnancy but then rapes her to reset the terms — she is now his prisoner, carrying and bound to deliver a son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the tone of coerced captivity that runs the whole season.

beats.label: S5 · Andy's confession, refused
beats.text: Andy confesses his love and begs Nancy to flee to Copenhagen with him; she refuses and moves in with Esteban, breaking Andy for months.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Defines Andy's arc — everything he does from here reacts to this rejection.

beats.label: S5 · Till fed to the cartel
beats.text: Nancy hands captured DEA Captain Till to Esteban to be murdered — buying her family's survival by feeding her old handler to the cartel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes out the DEA thread and shows how far Nancy will go now.

beats.label: S5 · Silas, Doug, Celia sell on the side
beats.text: Silas and Doug open a legal pot shop; broke Celia squats at Nancy's and bootstraps her own dealing operation alongside a cosmetics gig.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Keeps the peripheral cast active while Nancy is locked in the compound.

beats.label: S5 · Stevie and Pilar's objection
beats.text: Nancy delivers Esteban's son Stevie; Esteban proposes marriage but political fixer Pilar Zuazo objects to an American wife tarnishing his run for governor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Pilar and the political stakes that drive the finale.

beats.label: S5 · The wedding and the hit that misses
beats.text: After Pilar has Nancy shot at — grazing Shane instead — Nancy and Esteban marry anyway, and Nancy secretly asks Guillermo to have Pilar killed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Escalates Nancy vs Pilar to open warfare.

beats.label: S5 · Croquet mallet
beats.text: The Pilar hit fails; poolside at a fundraiser, Pilar boasts she has bought Guillermo and will pick off Silas and Shane — Shane kills her with a croquet mallet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger and Shane's turning point.

cliffhanger.text: Shane has murdered a powerful cartel-tied political fixer poolside at his stepfather's fundraiser. The family is deep in the Reyes compound with her body.
questions: Can Nancy hide Pilar's corpse from Esteban and the cartel?
What happens if Cesar or Guillermo pieces together who killed her?
Will Shane collapse under the weight of what he's just done, or harden further?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Married to Esteban and mother of his newborn son; just watched her middle child kill Pilar.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Living in the Reyes compound; ran a pot shop with Doug until police pressure closed it.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Just murdered Pilar with a croquet mallet to protect the family from her threats.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Recovered from Nancy's rejection and newly engaged to obstetrician Audra.

characters.name: Stevie Ray Botwin
characters.line: Nancy and Esteban's newborn son, legally registered under Esteban's name.

characters.name: Esteban Reyes
characters.line: Running for governor of Baja California; just remarried Nancy for political optics.

characters.name: Pilar Zuazo
characters.line: Political fixer who threatened Nancy's sons — just killed by Shane in the season's final beat.

characters.name: Cesar
characters.line: Esteban's former enforcer, revealed as a traitor and shot by Nancy after setting her up to be killed.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: Ran the pot shop with Silas; feuding with Celia over stolen product.

beats.label: S6 · The Newmans
beats.text: Fleeing Pilar's body, the Botwins take on new identities as the Newmans, hide out in Seattle, and try to build a normal life under new names.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the whole season's premise — fugitives with false papers.

beats.label: S6 · Hash at the hotel
beats.text: Nancy scabs at a Seattle hotel and quickly starts dealing hash to guests; the scheme collapses the moment cops boot her van and threaten to trace the family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Nancy can't stop dealing even in hiding — the pattern that drives every stop.

beats.label: S6 · Cesar and Ignacio close in
beats.text: Cesar and Ignacio, feeding Esteban intelligence, use a captive Doug to track the Botwins; the pursuit catches up to them in Seattle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the cartel on their trail for the rest of the season.

beats.label: S6 · Diner standoff
beats.text: In a diner standoff, Shane takes his mother's gun; Ignacio, who has seen the boy's darkness up close, lets the family walk.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shane's darkness saves them, and Ignacio's mercy defines the pursuit.

beats.label: S6 · The RV road
beats.text: The Newmans plus Doug drift through Montana and Colorado in a beat-up RV, taking odd jobs while Nancy plans one final score to fund escape to Copenhagen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Copenhagen plan is what pulls them into the finale trap.

beats.label: S6 · Silas isn't Judah's son
beats.text: In Nancy's Dearborn hometown, a DNA test proves Judah wasn't Silas's father — an old flame named Lars is — and Silas decides to stay behind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates Silas's identity and briefly removes him from the family.

beats.label: S6 · Airport, FBI, confession
beats.text: Esteban and Guillermo find Nancy at Detroit airport; to save Stevie and her sons, she has Andy call the FBI and takes the fall for Pilar's murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger and the sacrifice that resets everything.

cliffhanger.text: Nancy is being arrested by the FBI outside the airport, confessing to Pilar's murder to save her family. Andy, Silas, Shane and Stevie are on a plane to Copenhagen; Esteban and Guillermo have just been caught.
questions: How long will Nancy serve for a murder she didn't commit?
What becomes of Esteban and Guillermo now that their cover is blown?
Can the Botwin men build a life abroad without her?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Just took the fall for Pilar's murder to save her family, in FBI custody outside Detroit airport.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Learned Judah wasn't his father but rejoined the family on the plane at the last moment.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Hardened killer whose willingness to pull a trigger has become the family's most dangerous asset.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Reluctant father-figure to Stevie, now boarding a plane to Copenhagen with the boys.

characters.name: Stevie Ray Botwin
characters.line: Nancy's toddler son, on the plane out of the country with Andy and his brothers.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: Betrayed the family under duress, then joined them on the run through the west and midwest.

characters.name: Esteban Reyes
characters.line: Just captured by the FBI at Detroit airport alongside Nancy.

characters.name: Cesar
characters.line: Esteban's enforcer who chased the Botwins across the country.

characters.name: Guillermo
characters.line: Escaped from a Mexican prison and helped Esteban corner Nancy at the airport.

beats.label: S7 · Paroled to New York
beats.text: Three years later, Nancy is paroled from prison to a halfway house in New York — Esteban has been murdered inside and the cartel disbanded.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the geography, timeline and threat landscape for the whole season.

beats.label: S7 · Family reconvenes
beats.text: The Botwins converge on New York; Andy, Shane, Silas, Doug and Stevie — raised by Nancy's sister Jill — reassemble around their released mother.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Jill and the custody situation that becomes the season's spine.

beats.label: S7 · Dealing again, custody looming
beats.text: Nancy restarts dealing through her prison girlfriend Zoya's brother Demetri, while Jill sues for full custody of Stevie — the son Nancy hasn't raised in years.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two engines of the season: Nancy relapsing into the trade and losing her son legally.

beats.label: S7 · Back to Heylia
beats.text: For a real supply, Nancy crawls back to Heylia — who agrees only if Silas moves in and grows the MILF strain himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reactivates the show's oldest supply relationship and puts Silas in charge of the crop.

beats.label: S7 · Silas declares competition
beats.text: Silas partners with rival Emma and — after Nancy has Emma arrested — steals the sales database and declares himself Nancy's competition.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits the Botwin operation in two and sets up the reconciliation.

beats.label: S7 · Signing Stevie away
beats.text: Mother and son reconcile too late: Jill blackmails Nancy into signing over Stevie for good, and Nancy accepts to keep the family free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The emotional close of Nancy's custody arc.

beats.label: S7 · Sniper in the bushes
beats.text: At a family dinner in Connecticut, an unseen sniper lines up on Nancy and shoots her in the head.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger.

cliffhanger.text: Nancy has just been shot in the head by an unseen sniper at a Connecticut family dinner. The shooter's identity is unknown.
questions: Who pulled the trigger — Heylia, a cartel remnant, or someone else from her past?
Will Nancy survive the shot?
What holds the family together if she doesn't?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Freshly paroled and back to dealing in New York; just shot in the head by an unseen sniper.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Reconciled with Nancy after briefly splitting off with a rival syndicate; running the family business.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Training to become an NYPD police officer under detective Ouellette's mentorship.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Sharing loose custody duties around Stevie.

characters.name: Stevie Ray Botwin
characters.line: Legally in Jill's custody now — Nancy signed him over to protect the family from exposure.

characters.name: Jill Price-Grey
characters.line: Nancy's estranged sister who raised Stevie for three years and now has legal custody.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: CFO of hedge fund Vehement after helping cover for a fraud scheme aimed at pensioners.

characters.name: Heylia James
characters.line: Nancy's old supplier again after grovelling; recently threatened Nancy at gunpoint over the crop.

characters.name: Detective Mitch Ouellette
characters.line: NYPD investigator mentoring Shane; determined to arrest Nancy.

beats.label: S8 · Coma and pursuit
beats.text: Nancy survives the head shot but is put in a medically induced coma; Shane hunts the shooter and Andy quietly resumes sleeping with Jill.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reopens the season on the S7 cliffhanger and re-triangulates Andy and Jill.

beats.label: S8 · Tim Scottson revealed
beats.text: Nancy wakes vowing to go straight; the shooter turns out to be Tim Scottson, Peter's grown son, whom they hand over to the police.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the shooter mystery by dragging in an old debt from S1-S2.

beats.label: S8 · Pharma jobs
beats.text: Silas and Nancy take legitimate jobs at a pharmaceutical company selling a cannabis-based cancer pill, tempting Nancy back into dealing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames Nancy's central struggle — she cannot stay legitimate for long.

beats.label: S8 · Shane and Doug diverge
beats.text: Shane graduates the police academy and dates fellow cadet Angela; Doug builds a fake homeless-shelter con by drugging the hostile poor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the two peripheral characters at opposite moral poles.

beats.label: S8 · Pills and a phantom pregnancy
beats.text: Nancy skims pills from the company to sell with Jill, whose fake pregnancy imploded her relationship with Andy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nancy relapses into the trade one last time; Andy-Jill dissolves.

beats.label: S8 · Return to Regrestic
beats.text: Back in rebuilt "Regrestic", Silas reunites with Megan and confesses to sabotaging the condoms years earlier; the two reconcile.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Silas's oldest wound.

beats.label: S8 · Andy leaves; bar mitzvah
beats.text: After a final sexual encounter at the spot Judah died, Andy leaves Nancy for good despite her tearful pleas.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The series closes on Andy's departure and Nancy's attempt at repair.

cliffhanger.text: The series leaves Nancy alone at the spot Judah died, Andy gone for good despite her tearful pleas.
questions: Can Nancy hold what remains of her family together?
Will she stay out of the trade for good this time?
What kind of adult will Stevie become in Jill's household?

characters.name: Nancy Botwin
characters.line: Survived being shot, briefly went legitimate; left by Andy after one last encounter at the spot Judah died.

characters.name: Silas Botwin
characters.line: Reunited with old girlfriend Megan and growing pot legally at a pharmaceutical company.

characters.name: Shane Botwin
characters.line: Graduated the NYPD police academy and dating fellow cadet Angela.

characters.name: Andy Botwin
characters.line: Left Nancy for good after a final sexual encounter at the spot Judah died.

characters.name: Stevie Ray Botwin
characters.line: Nancy's youngest son with Esteban; still Jill's legal son.

characters.name: Jill Price-Grey
characters.line: Faked a pregnancy that ended her thing with Andy; briefly dealt pills alongside Nancy.

characters.name: Doug Wilson
characters.line: Running a fake homeless-shelter cult after his charity fraud caught up with him.
